title: Foundations: Pentatonic Mastery and Loop Pedal Integration (8 weeks)
skill: Electric guitar technique with pentatonic scales and loop pedal usage
north_star_capability: Be able to freely play melodies using pentatonic scales on the electric guitar and use a loop pedal to create backing tracks and harmonies for blues riffs.
sources: Major Pentatonic: The Five Patterns | JustinGuitar.com
Pentatonic Scale Guitar: Complete Guide Beyond the Box
A Live Looping Lesson - Premier Guitar
A Guide to Loopers and How to Use Them - Acoustic Guitar
4 EASY Ways To Use A Metronome And Practice Guitar - YouTube
The Essentials of Guitar Ergonomics: Pain-Free Playing - Kyser
assumptions: Practices 30 minutes per day, 5 days per week, for 8 weeks.
Access to a loop pedal capable of recording, overdubbing, and playback.
Standard tuning and basic amp settings assumed.
Practice environment allows use of a metronome.
No external performance requirement during the horizon.
